organizations.name: Open Door Bird Sanctuary
organizations.blurb: Raptor sanctuary and nature center on 40 wooded acres above the lakeshore.

organizations.name: Community Food Rescue
organizations.blurb: Partnership between Lakeshore CAP, Destination Sturgeon Bay, and Door County Mutual Aid. Bringing food to those in need.

opportunities.schedule: At least once a week. Raptor nights are Mondays and Thursdays.
opportunities.title: Raptor Team Member
opportunities.description: Train to handle the sanctuary's birds of prey: work directly with the raptors and help keep their enclosures clean. Handlers get hands-on training before working with the birds.

opportunities.schedule: Variable — depends on which events are scheduled.
opportunities.title: Education Team Member
opportunities.description: Help the public connect with the birds without handling them yourself. Work alongside the handlers at events, talk with visitors, and learn to teach people about the raptors.

opportunities.title: Food Rescuer
opportunities.description: Hand out bags to vendors at the farmer's market at 10:45, collect the bags at 11:45, then take the bags to Lakeshore CAP to weigh, document the weight contributed by each vendor, and store the food in the fridge.
